units.afterSourceText: 环哥娶亲有限，花上三千两银子，不拘那里省一抿子也就够了。老太太事出来，一应都是全了的，不过零星杂项，便费也满破三五千两。如今再俭省些，陆续也就够了。只怕如今平空又生出一两件事来，可就了不得了。──咱们且别虑后事，你且吃了饭，快听他商议什么。这正碰了我的机会，我正愁没个膀臂。虽有个宝玉，他又不是这里头的货，纵收伏了他也不中用。大奶奶是个佛爷，也不中用。二姑娘更不中用，亦且不是这屋里的人。四姑娘小呢。兰小子更小。环儿更是个燎毛的小冻猫子，只等有热灶火炕让他钻去罢。真真一个娘肚子里跑出这个天悬地隔的两个人来，我想到这里就不伏。

segments.text: ‘Huan’s wedding won’t cost much. Three thousand taels will do; a little saving somewhere or other would cover it. When the old lady’s time comes, all the main things are ready. There will only be odds and ends to pay for, three to five thousand taels at the outside. With a little more economy now, we can make it up by degrees. What worries me is some unexpected business cropping up, a thing or two out of nowhere. That would be disastrous. But leave the future for now. Eat your meal and hurry back to hear what she wants to discuss. This is just the opportunity I need. I’ve been fretting for want of a right arm. There’s Bao-yu, but he isn’t made for this sort of thing. Even if I won him over, he’d be no use. Mrs Zhu is a living Buddha, and no use either. The Second Miss is still less use, and doesn’t belong to this branch of the family in any case. The Fourth Miss is young, and little Lan younger still. As for Huan, he’s a half-frozen kitten with singed fur, only waiting for a hot stove or heated kang to crawl into. To think that two such utterly different creatures came out of the same mother’s belly! I can’t reconcile myself to it when I think of that.

units.afterSourceText: 若是在这里，琴儿过去了，好再商议你这事。离了这里就完了。如今不先完了他妹妹的事，也断不敢先娶亲的。如今倒是一件难事。再迟两年，又怕你熬煎出病来。等我和妈再商议，有人欺负你，你只管耐些烦儿，千万别自己熬煎出病来。不如把那一两银子明儿也越性给了他们，倒都歇心。你以后也不用白给那些人东西吃，他尖刺让他们去尖刺，很听不过了，各人走开。倘或短了什么，你别存那小家儿女气，只管找我去。

segments.text: ‘If they were here, Bao-qin could be married, and then we could discuss your wedding. Once you were out of this place, your troubles would be over. But until his sister is married, Xue Ke would never venture to marry first. It is a difficulty. If we wait another two years, I’m afraid you’ll worry yourself ill. I’ll discuss it with Mother. If people bully you, try to bear with them, and whatever you do, don’t make yourself ill with worry. You might as well send the other tael to your parents tomorrow too, and have done with it. Then everyone can be easy in their minds. And you needn’t keep giving those people things to eat for nothing. Let them make their sharp remarks. If it becomes too much to listen to, walk away. If you’re short of anything, don’t stand on the timid pride of a girl from a small family. Come to me.
